messages:
mike: Heads-up — canary for strict fncall validator is surfacing a spike of `validation_reject` errors on several customer routes. Not expected, customers seeing 400s. :eyes:

anya: saw it. the console only shows an aggregate "reject rate" metric, no breakdown by reject reason. we need per-reason telemetry so SRE/product can triage quickly.

devin: digging into logs, looks like some tool adapters are returning arrays where validators expect objects. example log snippet: ```ValidatorError: expected object at tools.contact.create -> got Array
payload: ["id","name"]
stack: ...```

lisa-product: customers are filing tickets claiming a quota/limit. UI is ambiguous so they think it's quota rather than fncall validation. UX problem.

sam-ml: another gap: when we fallback to permissive-model the validation metric isn't incremented (we only count hard rejects). so telemetry underreports total validation noise.

anya: proposal: 1) add `validation.reason` tag on samples/events, 2) expose per-route per-reason counts in the console (redacted payloads), 3) add a `validation_score` gauge (0-1) emitted by validators for soft decisions. sampling + redaction for privacy.

devin: code changes are straightforward. main blockers: retention cost for storing samples and PII concerns. we can do 1% sampling + deterministic hashing of known sensitive fields.

mike: immediate mitigation: enable soft mode on the canary routes so validators log and annotate but don't block. example API patch to toggle: ```PATCH /v1/routes/rt_123/config
{ \"fncall_validator\": { \"mode\": \"soft\" } }```

deploy-bot: Canary rollout update: 2/5 hosts updated. Health checks passing. Revert window open.

lisa-product: +1 for soft mode. also add a short tooltip/CTA in console explaining the difference between 'validation rejection' and 'quota' errors so support can triage.

anya: add an alert rule: trigger when `validation.reject_rate` > 2% for 5min AND `http.5xx_rate` does not increase — that suggests validation noise rather than backend failures.

devin: I'll draft the telemetry PR and an RFC for sample retention/redaction rules. assigning to @devin, ETA EOD tomorrow.

mike: thanks — file a follow-up ticket in eng-platform backlog and add this to next oncall rotation. :thumbsup:
